safeguard_execution.action_taken: Clean break from training loop; prevented non-finite tensor serialization to EXP-MLUA-001_LATEST.pth

epoch_train_loss.feeder_types: Running sum of total_loss.item() Python floats across 265 training batches
epoch_train_loss.reduction_method: Python scalar arithmetic (float sum divided by integer batch count)
epoch_train_loss.numerical_behavior: Finite if all 265 total_loss floats are finite

mean_val_loss.feeder_types: List of 13 validation batch loss floats (bce_loss_fn + dice_loss_fn)
mean_val_loss.reduction_method: numpy.mean over list of 13 float scalars
mean_val_loss.numerical_behavior: Finite if all 13 validation batch loss floats are finite

mean_val_dice.feeder_types: List of 13 validation batch Dice score floats from calculate_metrics_batch
mean_val_dice.reduction_method: numpy.mean over list of 13 float scalars
mean_val_dice.numerical_behavior: Finite if calculate_metrics_batch returns finite floats for all 13 batches

exact_runtime_nan_source.rationale: Because the safeguard cleanly executed a loop break before serialization, the partial aborted Epoch 23 record was never written to EXP-MLUA-001_FULL_TRAINING_HISTORY.csv or EXP-MLUA-001_LATEST.pth. The last serialized state on disk is Epoch 22.

failure_classification.contributing_factor: EXTREME_FOREGROUND_SUPPRESSION (39/50 validation cases producing 0 foreground pixels at threshold 0.5, collapsing predicted prevalence to 0.036% and recall to 0.046%)
